paths.name: New California Disney role
paths.trigger: Written offer plus an agreed work location and start transition.
current_actions: Prepare for and attend the hiring-manager interview
Clarify title, location, start timing, office cadence, compensation and relocation support if the process advances
paths.notes: Do not keep volunteering to waive relocation support. Let Disney/HR state what applies.

paths.name: Relocate current role to Glendale
paths.trigger: Leadership approval plus an HR-approved work-location change.
paths.current_state: Manager Michael is supportive and has investigated the process. Lane must initiate official intent, build a Glendale business justification, obtain leadership approval, then involve HR.
open_questions: What business justification or evidence is required?
What is the expected in-office cadence?
What is the official work-location effective date?
Can there be a remote transition period?
paths.notes: Employment continuity may simplify risk and sequencing. It does NOT make the physical move cheaper - the same rent, household move, road trip, deposits and setup costs still exist unless Disney covers them.

paths.name: Continued selective Disney California search
paths.trigger: A different California Disney role becomes professionally actionable and is a strong enough fit.
philosophy: Prefer Principal / Lead-caliber roles where appropriate
Generally look outside Disney Experiences, with Imagineering as the dream exception
Do not chase a weak-fit role to satisfy the March target
A career change should improve or at least preserve Lane's financial position
